```{r}
#' Left-aligned bold plotly title with optional subtitle.
plotly_title <- function(title, subtitle = NULL) {
  sub_txt <- if (!is.null(subtitle) && nzchar(subtitle)) {
    paste0("<br><span style='font-size:12px;color:#555555;line-height:1.35'>", subtitle, "</span>")
  } else ""
  list(
    text = paste0("<b style='font-size:17px'>", title, "</b>", sub_txt),
    x = 0.02, xanchor = "left",
    y = 0.99, yanchor = "top",
    automargin = TRUE,
    pad = list(t = 10, b = 10)
  )
}

#' Shared layout for plotly scattergeo maps — reserves space so titles are not clipped.
plotly_map_layout <- function(title, subtitle = NULL, legend = NULL, lataxis_range = NULL) {
  has_sub <- !is.null(subtitle) && nzchar(subtitle)
  geo <- list(
    projection = list(type = "natural earth"),
    showland = TRUE, landcolor = "#f0f0f0",
    showocean = TRUE, oceancolor = "#e6f2fa",
    showcountries = TRUE, countrycolor = "#bbbbbb",
    domain = list(x = c(0, 1), y = c(0, if (has_sub) 0.82 else 0.88))
  )
  if (!is.null(lataxis_range)) geo$lataxis <- list(range = lataxis_range)

  out <- list(
    title = plotly_title(title, subtitle),
    margin = list(
      t = if (has_sub) min(150, 95 + nchar(subtitle) %/% 45 * 14) else 75,
      b = if (!is.null(legend)) 60 else 12,
      l = 0, r = 0
    ),
    geo = geo
  )
  if (!is.null(legend)) out$legend <- legend
  out
}

#' Apply shared scattergeo layout (plotly::layout does not support rlang `!!!`).
layout_geo_map <- function(p, title, subtitle = NULL, legend = NULL, lataxis_range = NULL) {
  do.call(plotly::layout, c(list(p), plotly_map_layout(title, subtitle, legend, lataxis_range)))
}

#' Minimal ggplot theme: bold left title, subtitle guidance, grid on demand.
#'
#' @param grid `"none"`, `"x"`, `"y"`, or `"xy"` — major grid lines only where they aid reading.
theme_clean <- function(grid = "none") {
  grid <- match.arg(grid, c("none", "x", "y", "xy"))
  base <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11, base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0,
        margin = margin(b = 4), colour = "grey10"
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 10.5, hjust = 0, colour = "grey35",
        margin = margin(b = 10), lineheight = 1.15
      ),
      plot.caption = element_text(
        size = 9, hjust = 0, colour = "grey45",
        margin = margin(t = 10), lineheight = 1.2
      ),
      plot.margin = margin(12, 16, 10, 10),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9.5),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.45, "cm"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10, colour = "grey20"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 8)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey30"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9.5, colour = "grey15"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey96", colour = NA),
      panel.spacing = unit(1.1, "lines")
    )
  grid_theme <- switch(grid,
    none = theme(panel.grid = element_blank()),
    x = theme(
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey91", linewidth = 0.35),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ),
    y = theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey91", linewidth = 0.35),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ),
    xy = theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey91", linewidth = 0.35),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  )
  base + grid_theme
}
```

### Site tables

**`n_metadata`** = rows in the archive; **`n_with_data`** = series with values in 0–2000 CE.

```{r}
#| label: speleothem-helpers
#| code-fold: true

#' One row per speleothem series with site metadata.
#'
#' @param catalog Long catalog from [load_dod2k_catalog()].
#' @param compact Wide compact table (for site names).
#' @return Tibble with `dataset_id`, coords, year range, `n_years`, `site`.
speleothem_sites <- function(catalog, compact) {
  sites <- catalog |>
    filter(archive_type == "Speleothem") |>
    group_by(dataset_id, proxy_type, lon, lat) |>
    summarize(
      year_start = min(year),
      year_end = max(year),
      n_years = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  meta <- compact |>
    filter(archiveType == "Speleothem") |>
    dplyr::select(dataset_id, geo_siteName) |>
    rename(site = geo_siteName)

  sites |>
    left_join(meta, by = "dataset_id") |>
    mutate(
      site = if_else(is.na(site) | site == "" | site == dataset_id, dataset_id, site),
      proxy_type = factor(proxy_type, levels = proxy_order)
    )
}

#' Count metadata rows vs. series with usable time series, by proxy type.
#'
#' @param compact Wide compact table.
#' @param catalog Long catalog.
#' @return Tibble: `proxy_label`, `proxy_type`, `n_metadata`, `n_with_data`.
speleothem_summary <- function(compact, catalog) {
  meta <- compact |>
    filter(archiveType == "Speleothem") |>
    count(paleoData_proxy, name = "n_metadata") |>
    rename(proxy_type = paleoData_proxy)

  with_data <- catalog |>
    filter(archive_type == "Speleothem") |>
    distinct(dataset_id, proxy_type) |>
    count(proxy_type, name = "n_with_data")

  meta |>
    full_join(with_data, by = "proxy_type") |>
    mutate(
      n_metadata = replace_na(n_metadata, 0L),
      n_with_data = replace_na(n_with_data, 0L),
      proxy_label = proxy_labels[proxy_type],
      proxy_type = factor(proxy_type, levels = proxy_order)
    ) |>
    arrange(proxy_type) |>
    transmute(proxy_label, proxy_type, n_metadata, n_with_data)
}
```

```{r}
#' Interactive plotly map of speleothem sites.

#' @param sites Output of [speleothem_sites()].

plot_speleothem_map <- function(sites) {
  sites <- sites |>
    mutate(
      proxy_label = proxy_labels[as.character(proxy_type)],
      hover = paste0(
        "<b>", site, "</b><br>", dataset_id, "<br>",
        "Proxy: ", proxy_label, "<br>",
        "Years: ", year_start, "–", year_end, " (n = ", n_years, ")"
      )
    )

  p <- plot_ly(type = "scattergeo", mode = "markers")
  for (px in proxy_order) {
    sub <- filter(sites, as.character(proxy_type) == px)
    if (!nrow(sub)) next
    p <- add_trace(
      p, data = sub, lon = ~lon, lat = ~lat, text = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text",
      name = paste0("Speleothem: ", proxy_labels[[px]], " (n=", nrow(sub), ")"),
      marker = list(
        symbol = proxy_symbols[[px]], size = 9,
        color = proxy_colors[[px]], line = list(width = 0.6, color = "#333")
      )
    )
  }
  layout_geo_map(
    p,
    "DoD2k speleothem archive",
    paste0(nrow(sites), " series — symbol = proxy type; hover for site name and year range"),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.02, x = 0.02, xanchor = "left"),
    lataxis_range = c(-40, 75)
  )
}
```

```{r}
#' Stacked bar chart — series count per time bin.

plot_speleothem_density <- function(catalog, bin_width = 100) {

    geom_col(width = bin_width * 0.9, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = proxy_colors, labels = proxy_labels[proxy_order], name = "Proxy type") +

    labs(
      title = "Where observations exist",
      subtitle = "Series with at least one dated value per 100-year bin, stacked by proxy type",
      caption = "Watch for: pre-1600 gaps and whether δ18O dominates recent centuries.",
      y = "Series with data"
    ) +
    theme_clean(grid = "y")
}
```

# Screen against instrumental climate

Each speleothem series is compared to the **nearest CRU grid box** (0.5°): annual mean temperature, JJA temperature, and annual precipitation [@harris2020]. We use **Pearson correlation on raw annual values** (1901–2000) — no detrending in Step 1 (see Step 2 for when and why we detrend). A series needs at least 10 overlapping years.

## CRU grid extraction

```{r}
#| label: cru-setup
#| code-fold: true

cru_dir  <- file.path(cache_dir, "cru_ts")
cru_base <- "https://crudata.uea.ac.uk/cru/data/hrg/cru_ts_4.07/cruts.2304141047.v4.07"
cru_years <- 1901:2022
cru_rds   <- file.path(cache_dir, "cru_site_climate.rds")
dir.create(cru_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

#' Download and decompress one CRU TS variable if needed.
#'
#' @param var `"tmp"` or `"pre"`.
#' @return Path to the uncompressed NetCDF file.
ensure_cru_nc <- function(var) {
  fname <- paste0("cru_ts4.07.1901.2022.", var, ".dat.nc")
  nc_path <- file.path(cru_dir, fname)
  gz_path <- paste0(nc_path, ".gz")
  if (!file.exists(nc_path)) {
    if (!file.exists(gz_path)) {
      message("Downloading CRU TS ", var, " …")
      url <- paste(cru_base, var, paste0(fname, ".gz"), sep = "/")
      if (nzchar(Sys.which("curl"))) {
        status <- system2("curl", c("-L", "-C", "-", "--retry", "3", "--max-time", "900", "-o", gz_path, url))
        if (status != 0) stop("CRU download failed for ", var)
      } else {
        utils::download.file(url, gz_path, mode = "wb", timeout = 900)
      }
    }
    message("Decompressing ", basename(gz_path), " …")
    status <- system2("gunzip", c("-k", "-f", gz_path))
    if (status != 0) stop("gunzip failed — decompress ", gz_path, " manually")
  }
  nc_path
}

#' Aggregate monthly CRU matrices to annual temperature means and precipitation sums.
cru_monthly_to_annual <- function(mat_tmp, mat_pre, years = cru_years) {
  n_pt <- nrow(mat_tmp)
  n_yr <- length(years)
  tmp_ann <- tmp_jja <- pre_ann <- matrix(NA_real_, n_pt, n_yr)
  for (j in seq_len(n_yr)) {
    m <- (j - 1L) * 12L + 1:12
    tmp_ann[, j] <- rowMeans(mat_tmp[, m, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    tmp_jja[, j] <- rowMeans(mat_tmp[, m[6:8], drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    pre_ann[, j] <- rowSums(mat_pre[, m, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  list(tmp_ann = tmp_ann, tmp_jja = tmp_jja, pre_ann = pre_ann)
}

#' Extract CRU TS climate at speleothem locations (cached as RDS).
#'
#' @param loc Tibble with `loc_id`, `lon`, `lat`.
#' @param refresh Rebuild even when RDS exists.
#' @return Long tibble: `loc_id`, `lon`, `lat`, `year`, `tmp_ann`, `tmp_jja`, `pre_ann`.
load_cru_site_climate <- function(loc, refresh = FALSE) {
  if (!refresh && file.exists(cru_rds)) return(readRDS(cru_rds))

  pts <- vect(loc, geom = c("lon", "lat"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
  tmp_nc <- ensure_cru_nc("tmp")
  pre_nc <- ensure_cru_nc("pre")

  mat_tmp <- as.matrix(
    terra::extract(rast(tmp_nc, subds = "tmp"), pts, method = "simple")[, -1]
  )
  mat_pre <- as.matrix(
    terra::extract(rast(pre_nc, subds = "pre"), pts, method = "simple")[, -1]
  )
  ann <- cru_monthly_to_annual(mat_tmp, mat_pre)

  clim <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(loc)), \(i) {
    tibble(
      loc_id = loc$loc_id[i], lon = loc$lon[i], lat = loc$lat[i],
      year = cru_years,
      tmp_ann = ann$tmp_ann[i, ], tmp_jja = ann$tmp_jja[i, ], pre_ann = ann$pre_ann[i, ]
    )
  })
  saveRDS(clim, cru_rds)
  clim
}
```

## Correlation functions

Pearson correlation with two-tailed p-value; series with fewer than 10 overlap years are skipped.

```{r}
#| label: corr-setup
#| code-fold: true
#| cache: true

instr_y0 <- 1901L
instr_y1 <- 2000L
min_overlap <- 10L

climate_vars <- c(
  r_tmp_ann = "Temperature (annual)",
  r_tmp_jja = "Temperature (JJA)",
  r_pre_ann = "Precipitation (annual)"
)
climate_p_labels <- setNames(unname(climate_vars), c("tmp_ann", "tmp_jja", "pre_ann"))

#' Correlate one proxy series with one climate variable.
corr_series <- function(proxy_df, clim_df, clim_col,
                        y0 = instr_y0, y1 = instr_y1, min_n = min_overlap) {
  d <- proxy_df |>
    filter(year >= y0, year <= y1) |>
    inner_join(clim_df, by = "year")
  ok <- is.finite(d$value) & is.finite(d[[clim_col]])
  d <- d[ok, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(d) < min_n) {
    return(tibble(r = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, n = nrow(d)))
  }
  ct <- cor.test(d$value, d[[clim_col]], method = "pearson")
  tibble(r = unname(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value, n = nrow(d))
}

#' Build annual speleothem series (mean if multiple values per year).
speleothem_annual <- function(catalog) {
  catalog |>
    filter(archive_type == "Speleothem") |>
    group_by(dataset_id, proxy_type, lon, lat, year) |>
    summarize(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop")
}

#' Correlate all speleothem series with local CRU grid-box climate.
compute_speleo_correlations <- function(catalog, clim, sites,
                                        y0 = instr_y0, y1 = instr_y1) {
  loc <- sites |> distinct(lon, lat) |> mutate(loc_id = row_number())
  proxy_ann <- speleothem_annual(catalog) |> inner_join(loc, by = c("lon", "lat"))

  res <- map_dfr(group_split(proxy_ann, dataset_id), function(df) {
    cdf <- clim |> filter(loc_id == df$loc_id[1])
    t1 <- corr_series(df, cdf, "tmp_ann", y0, y1)
    t2 <- corr_series(df, cdf, "tmp_jja", y0, y1)
    t3 <- corr_series(df, cdf, "pre_ann", y0, y1)
    tibble(
      dataset_id = df$dataset_id[1],
      proxy_type = df$proxy_type[1],
      lon = df$lon[1], lat = df$lat[1],
      n_overlap = t1$n,
      r_tmp_ann = t1$r, p_tmp_ann = t1$p,
      r_tmp_jja = t2$r, p_tmp_jja = t2$p,
      r_pre_ann = t3$r, p_pre_ann = t3$p
    )
  })

  res |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      best_var = {
        rs <- c(tmp_ann = r_tmp_ann, tmp_jja = r_tmp_jja, pre_ann = r_pre_ann)
        if (all(is.na(rs))) NA_character_ else names(rs)[which.max(abs(rs))]
      },
      best_r = {
        rs <- c(r_tmp_ann, r_tmp_jja, r_pre_ann)
        if (all(is.na(rs))) NA_real_ else rs[which.max(abs(rs))]
      }
    ) |>
    ungroup()
}

#' Add display labels to correlation results.
enrich_correlations <- function(corr) {
  corr |>
    mutate(
      proxy_type = factor(proxy_type, levels = proxy_order),
      proxy_label = proxy_labels[as.character(proxy_type)],
      best_var_label = recode(
        best_var,
        tmp_ann = "Temperature (annual)",
        tmp_jja = "Temperature (JJA)",
        pre_ann = "Precipitation (annual)",
        .default = NA_character_
      ),
      best_p = case_when(
        best_var == "tmp_ann" ~ p_tmp_ann,
        best_var == "tmp_jja" ~ p_tmp_jja,
        best_var == "pre_ann" ~ p_pre_ann,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    )
}
```

## All stations

```{r}
#| label: corr-run
#| cache: true
#| dependson: speleothem-summary

corr_rds <- file.path(cache_dir, "speleo_instrument_correlations.rds")
cru_locs <- speleo_sites |> distinct(lon, lat) |> mutate(loc_id = row_number())

if (file.exists(corr_rds) && file.exists(cru_rds)) {
  speleo_corr <- enrich_correlations(readRDS(corr_rds))
} else {
  cru_clim <- load_cru_site_climate(cru_locs)
  speleo_corr <- enrich_correlations(compute_speleo_correlations(catalog, cru_clim, speleo_sites))
  saveRDS(speleo_corr, corr_rds)
}

n_tested <- sum(is.finite(speleo_corr$best_r))
n_sig <- speleo_corr |>
  transmute(sig = p_tmp_ann < 0.05 | p_tmp_jja < 0.05 | p_pre_ann < 0.05) |>
  pull(sig) |>
  sum(na.rm = TRUE)
glue(
  "Series tested (≥{min_overlap} overlap years, {instr_y0}–{instr_y1}): {n_tested}  |  ",
  "Significant (p < 0.05, any variable): {n_sig}"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: corr-summary-table
#| dependson: corr-run

speleo_corr |>
  filter(is.finite(r_tmp_ann) | is.finite(r_pre_ann)) |>
  group_by(proxy_type) |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    median_r_tmp = median(r_tmp_ann, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_r_pre = median(r_pre_ann, na.rm = TRUE),
    sig_tmp = sum(p_tmp_ann < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    sig_pre = sum(p_pre_ann < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(proxy_label = proxy_labels[as.character(proxy_type)]) |>
  transmute(
    proxy_label, n, median_r_tmp, median_r_pre, sig_tmp, sig_pre
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    digits = 3,
    caption = paste0("Local CRU correlations by proxy type (", instr_y0, "–", instr_y1, ")")
  )
```

Distribution of correlation coefficients across all series — weak median correlations are typical for heterogeneous archives (cf. Exercise 12).

```{r}
#| label: corr-histogram-fn

#' Histogram of correlation coefficients, faceted by climate variable.
plot_correlation_histogram <- function(corr) {
  long <- corr |>
    filter(is.finite(r_tmp_ann) | is.finite(r_tmp_jja) | is.finite(r_pre_ann)) |>
    pivot_longer(
      c(r_tmp_ann, r_tmp_jja, r_pre_ann),
      names_to = "climate", values_to = "r"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      climate = factor(climate, levels = names(climate_vars), labels = climate_vars),
      proxy_type = factor(proxy_type, levels = proxy_order)
    )

  ggplot(long, aes(r, fill = proxy_type)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, alpha = 0.75, position = "identity") +
    facet_wrap(~climate, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = proxy_colors, labels = proxy_labels[proxy_order], name = "Proxy type") +
    labs(
      title = "Proxy–climate correlations (all speleothem series)",
      subtitle = paste0("Local CRU grid box, ", instr_y0, "–", instr_y1),
      x = "Pearson r", y = "Count"
    ) +
    theme_clean(grid = "y")
}
```

## By proxy type

Compare temperature vs. precipitation fit and count significant correlations (p < 0.05).

```{r}
#| label: corr-by-type-fn
#| code-fold: true
#| cache: true

#' Boxplot of correlations by proxy type and climate variable (one panel per target).
plot_correlation_by_type <- function(corr) {
  long <- corr |>
    pivot_longer(
      c(r_tmp_ann, r_tmp_jja, r_pre_ann),
      names_to = "climate", values_to = "r"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      climate = factor(climate, levels = names(climate_vars), labels = climate_vars),
      proxy_type = factor(proxy_type, levels = proxy_order)
    )

  ylim <- max(abs(long$r), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05
  climates <- levels(long$climate)

  map(climates, function(clim) {
    ggplot(long |> filter(climate == clim), aes(proxy_type, r, fill = proxy_type)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.7, alpha = 0.85) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = proxy_colors, guide = "none") +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = proxy_labels[proxy_order]) +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-ylim, ylim)) +
      labs(
        title = clim,
        subtitle = "Median and spread of Pearson r by proxy type",
        caption = if (clim == tail(climates, 1)) {
          "Boxes near zero across types → no single proxy consistently tracks local CRU."
        } else {
          NULL
        },
        x = NULL, y = "Pearson r"
      ) +
      theme_clean(grid = "y")
  })
}

#' Count significant correlations (p < 0.05) by proxy type and climate variable.
plot_significance_counts <- function(corr) {
  sig <- corr |>
    filter(!is.na(proxy_type), proxy_type %in% proxy_order) |>
    transmute(
      proxy_type,
      tmp_ann = p_tmp_ann < 0.05,
      tmp_jja = p_tmp_jja < 0.05,
      pre_ann = p_pre_ann < 0.05
    ) |>
    pivot_longer(-proxy_type, names_to = "climate", values_to = "sig") |>
    filter(!is.na(sig)) |>
    group_by(proxy_type, climate) |>
    summarize(n_sig = sum(sig), n_total = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(
      climate = factor(climate, levels = names(climate_p_labels), labels = climate_p_labels),
      proxy_type = factor(proxy_type, levels = proxy_order)
    )

  ggplot(sig, aes(proxy_type, n_total)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.65, fill = "grey88", colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_col(aes(y = n_sig, fill = proxy_type), width = 0.65) +
    geom_text(
      aes(y = n_total, label = paste0(n_sig, "/", n_total)),
      vjust = -0.35, size = 3.2, colour = "grey25"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~climate, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = proxy_colors, labels = proxy_labels[proxy_order], guide = "none") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = proxy_labels[proxy_order]) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    labs(
      title = "Significant correlations (p < 0.05)",
      subtitle = "Per climate target: grey = all series tested; colour = significant; label = sig/total",
      caption = "Totals can differ slightly across panels if some series lack overlap for one CRU variable.",
      x = NULL, y = "Number of series"
    ) +
    theme_clean(grid = "y") +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
}
```

```{r}

#| fig-width: 9

walk(plot_correlation_by_type(speleo_corr), print)
```

## Correlation map

Points coloured by the strongest local correlation (signed).

```{r}
#| label: corr-map-fn
#| code-fold: true
#| cache: true

#' Map speleothem sites coloured by best correlation with CRU climate.
plot_correlation_map <- function(corr) {
  fmt_p <- function(p) {
    out <- rep("NA", length(p))
    ok <- is.finite(p)
    out[ok] <- format.pval(p[ok], digits = 3, eps = 0.001)
    out
  }

  map_df <- corr |>
    filter(is.finite(best_r)) |>
    left_join(
      speleo_sites |> dplyr::select(dataset_id, site),
      by = "dataset_id"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      sig = is.finite(best_p) & best_p < 0.05,
      marker_size = if_else(sig, 9, 6),
      marker_lw = if_else(sig, 1.2, 0.4),
      hover = paste0(
        "<b>", site, "</b><br>", dataset_id, "<br>",
        proxy_labels[as.character(proxy_type)], "<br>",
        "T (annual): r = ", round(r_tmp_ann, 3), ", p = ", fmt_p(p_tmp_ann), "<br>",
        "T (JJA): r = ", round(r_tmp_jja, 3), ", p = ", fmt_p(p_tmp_jja), "<br>",
        "Precip (annual): r = ", round(r_pre_ann, 3), ", p = ", fmt_p(p_pre_ann), "<br>",
        "<b>Best: ", best_var_label, "</b><br>",
        "r = ", round(best_r, 3), ", p = ", fmt_p(best_p),
        " (n = ", n_overlap, ")",
        if_else(sig, " — significant", "")
      )
    )

  layout_geo_map(
    map_df |>
    plot_ly(
      type = "scattergeo", mode = "markers",
      lon = ~lon, lat = ~lat, text = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text",
      color = ~best_r, colors = c("#2166ac", "#f7f7f7", "#b2182b"),
      marker = list(
        size = ~marker_size,
        sizemode = "diameter",
        line = list(width = ~marker_lw, color = "#333")
      )
    ),
    "Best proxy–climate correlation",
    paste0(
      "Signed r at nearest CRU grid cell, ", instr_y0, "–", instr_y1,
      " — red = positive, blue = negative; larger points = p < 0.05 for best fit"
    )
  )
}
```

## Intermediate takeaways

```{r}
#| label: step1-takeaways-prep
#| include: false
#| dependson: corr-run

median_r_tmp <- median(speleo_corr$r_tmp_ann, na.rm = TRUE)
median_r_pre <- median(speleo_corr$r_pre_ann, na.rm = TRUE)
median_best_abs <- median(abs(speleo_corr$best_r), na.rm = TRUE)
pct_sig <- round(100 * n_sig / n_tested)

best_target <- speleo_corr |>
  filter(!is.na(best_var), proxy_type %in% proxy_order) |>
  count(proxy_type, best_var, name = "n") |>
  group_by(proxy_type) |>
  slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    proxy_label = proxy_labels[as.character(proxy_type)],
    target = recode(best_var,
      tmp_ann = "annual temperature",
      tmp_jja = "JJA temperature",
      pre_ann = "annual precipitation"
    )
  )

proxy_step1 <- speleo_corr |>
  filter(proxy_type %in% proxy_order, is.finite(best_r)) |>
  group_by(proxy_type) |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    median_r_tmp = median(r_tmp_ann, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_r_pre = median(r_pre_ann, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_best_abs_r = median(abs(best_r), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sig_best = sum(is.finite(best_p) & best_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(best_target |> dplyr::select(proxy_type, target, n_mode = n), by = "proxy_type") |>
  mutate(
    proxy_label = proxy_labels[as.character(proxy_type)],
    line = glue(
      "- **{proxy_label}** ({n} series): median *r* ≈ {sprintf('%.2f', median_r_tmp)} (T) and ",
      "{sprintf('%.2f', median_r_pre)} (precip); best-of-three median |*r*| ≈ ",
      "{sprintf('%.2f', median_best_abs_r)} ({n_sig_best} with p < 0.05). ",
      "*{target}* most often wins the |*r*| contest ({n_mode} series) — a relative choice, not a strong fit."
    )
  )

step1_proxy_bullets <- proxy_step1 |>
  pull(line) |>
  paste(collapse = "\n\n")
```

Across `r n_tested` series (`r instr_y0`–`r instr_y1`), **local proxy–climate correlations are essentially zero**: median *r* ≈ `r sprintf("%.2f", median_r_tmp)` for annual temperature and ≈ `r sprintf("%.2f", median_r_pre)` for annual precipitation. Even after picking the best of three CRU targets per series, the typical |*r*| is only ≈ `r sprintf("%.2f", median_best_abs)`. Only `r n_sig` series (`r pct_sig`%) reach *p* < 0.05 on any target — a minority, and most of those correlations remain weak. **No proxy type consistently tracks local CRU** in this coarse grid-box screening.

Per proxy type the picture is the same — near-zero medians; “best variable” is a weak relative winner:

`r step1_proxy_bullets`



# Regional composite reconstruction

We group caves into coarse regions, keep only series whose local correlation passes p < 0.05, **detrend** each series, build a **regional mean of sign-aligned proxy z-scores**, and calibrate that composite against the regional CRU mean (**1940–2020**). Validation uses the **earlier instrumental period (1901–1940)**.

## Detrending

| | Step 1 (screen) | Steps 2–3 (composite / ENSO) |
|--|-----------------|------------------------------|
| **Proxy** | raw annual values | linearly detrended |
| **CRU / Niño** | raw | raw (then z-scored for composites) |

**Method:** for each series, fit `value ~ year` by OLS on the years in the analysis window, subtract the fitted trend, add back the mean (function `detrend_linear()`). Minimum 5 finite points.



Previously we averaged per-cave reconstructions; that shrinks variance and makes the composite look flat on a shared y-axis even when correlation is non-zero.

## Regional bins and screening

```{r}
#| label: recon-setup
#| code-fold: true
#| cache: true

val_y0 <- 1901L
val_y1 <- 1939L
cal_y0 <- 1940L
cal_y1 <- 2020L
recon_y0 <- min(val_y0, cal_y0)
recon_y1 <- max(val_y1, cal_y1)
cal_period <- paste0(cal_y0, "–", cal_y1)
val_period <- paste0(val_y0, "–1940")   # validation era (years used: val_y0–val_y1)
min_screen_n <- 3L   # minimum screened series per region × target
screen_p <- 0.05

climate_col <- c(tmp_ann = "tmp_ann", tmp_jja = "tmp_jja", pre_ann = "pre_ann")
p_col <- c(tmp_ann = "p_tmp_ann", tmp_jja = "p_tmp_jja", pre_ann = "p_pre_ann")
r_col <- c(tmp_ann = "r_tmp_ann", tmp_jja = "r_tmp_jja", pre_ann = "r_pre_ann")

#' Assign coarse continent/region from coordinates (speleothem-focused bins).
assign_region <- function(lon, lat) {
  case_when(
    lat < -10 & lon > 100 ~ "Australasia",
    lat <= 15 & lon >= -85 & lon < -30 ~ "South America",
    lat > 15 & lon < -30 ~ "Americas (north)",
    lat >= 35 & lon >= -15 & lon < 45 ~ "Europe",
    lat >= -35 & lat < 40 & lon >= -20 & lon < 55 ~ "Africa / Med",
    lon >= 50 ~ "Asia",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}

#' Remove linear trend (preserve mean).
detrend_linear <- function(years, values) {
  ok <- is.finite(values)
  if (sum(ok) < 5L) return(rep(NA_real_, length(values)))
  fit <- lm(values[ok] ~ years[ok])
  resid <- values - predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(years = years))
  resid + mean(values[ok])
}

#' Z-score using reference years only.
zscore_ref <- function(x, years, ref_y0, ref_y1) {
  ref <- x[years >= ref_y0 & years <= ref_y1 & is.finite(x)]
  if (length(ref) < 5L) return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))
  s <- sd(ref)
  if (!is.finite(s) || s < 1e-8) return(rep(0, length(x)))
  (x - mean(ref)) / s
}

#' Screen series: significant p for assigned best climate variable.
screen_correlations <- function(corr, p_cut = screen_p) {
  corr |>
    mutate(
      region = assign_region(lon, lat),
      p_best = case_when(
        best_var == "tmp_ann" ~ p_tmp_ann,
        best_var == "tmp_jja" ~ p_tmp_jja,
        best_var == "pre_ann" ~ p_pre_ann,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      screened = is.finite(best_r) & !is.na(p_best) & p_best < p_cut & n_overlap >= min_overlap
    )
}

#' Calibrate one site; return annual recon + target in z-space.
calibrate_one_site <- function(proxy_df, clim_df, climate_var,
                               cal_y0, cal_y1, val_y0, val_y1) {
  col <- as.character(climate_col[[as.character(climate_var)]])
  d <- proxy_df |>
    inner_join(
      clim_df |> dplyr::transmute(year, climate = .data[[col]]),
      by = "year"
    ) |>
    filter(year >= recon_y0, year <= recon_y1)

  if (nrow(d) < min_overlap) return(NULL)

  d <- d |>
    mutate(
      proxy_dt = detrend_linear(year, value),
      proxy_z = zscore_ref(proxy_dt, year, cal_y0, cal_y1),
      climate_z = zscore_ref(climate, year, cal_y0, cal_y1)
    )

  cal <- d |> filter(year >= cal_y0, year <= cal_y1)
  ok <- complete.cases(cal[, c("proxy_z", "climate_z")])
  if (sum(ok) < min_overlap) return(NULL)

  fit <- lm(climate_z ~ proxy_z, data = cal[ok, ])
  d <- d |>
    mutate(recon_z = predict(fit, newdata = d))

  list(
    data = d |> dplyr::select(year, proxy_z, climate_z, recon_z),
    coef = coef(fit)
  )
}

#' Safe Pearson r (returns NA if fewer than 3 pairs).
safe_cor <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  if (sum(ok) < 3L) return(NA_real_)
  cor(x[ok], y[ok])
}

#' Build regional composites for each (region, climate_var) with enough screened series.
#'
#' Composite-first: average sign-aligned proxy z-scores per year, then calibrate once
#' against the regional CRU mean (avoids averaging per-site reconstructions, which
#' collapses amplitude toward zero).
build_regional_reconstructions <- function(corr, catalog, clim, sites) {
  loc <- sites |> distinct(lon, lat) |> mutate(loc_id = row_number())
  proxy_ann <- speleothem_annual(catalog) |> inner_join(loc, by = c("lon", "lat"))
  screened <- corr |> filter(screened)

  combos <- screened |>
    count(region, best_var, name = "n") |>
    filter(n >= min_screen_n, !is.na(best_var))

  if (!nrow(combos)) return(tibble())

  bind_rows(compact(map(seq_len(nrow(combos)), function(i) {
    reg <- combos$region[i]
    cv  <- combos$best_var[i]
    sub <- screened |> filter(region == reg, best_var == cv)
    col <- as.character(climate_col[[as.character(cv)]])

    site_proxy <- compact(map(sub$dataset_id, function(id) {
      row <- sub |> filter(dataset_id == id)
      px <- proxy_ann |> filter(dataset_id == id)
      cdf <- clim |> filter(loc_id == px$loc_id[1])
      d <- px |>
        inner_join(cdf |> dplyr::transmute(year, climate = .data[[col]]), by = "year") |>
        filter(year >= recon_y0, year <= recon_y1)

      if (nrow(d) < min_overlap) return(NULL)

      d |>
        mutate(
          proxy_dt = detrend_linear(year, value),
          proxy_z = zscore_ref(proxy_dt, year, cal_y0, cal_y1),
          sign_r = sign(row[[r_col[[cv]]]][1]),
          proxy_z_signed = if_else(sign_r < 0, -proxy_z, proxy_z)
        ) |>
        dplyr::select(year, proxy_z_signed)
    }))
    if (length(site_proxy) < min_screen_n) return(NULL)

    regional_clim <- map_dfr(sub$dataset_id, function(id) {
      px <- proxy_ann |> filter(dataset_id == id) |> slice(1)
      clim |>
        filter(loc_id == px$loc_id) |>
        dplyr::transmute(year, climate = .data[[col]])
    }) |>
      group_by(year) |>
      summarize(climate = mean(climate, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
      mutate(climate_z = zscore_ref(climate, year, cal_y0, cal_y1))

    composite <- bind_rows(site_proxy) |>
      group_by(year) |>
      summarize(proxy_z = mean(proxy_z_signed, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
      left_join(regional_clim |> dplyr::select(year, climate_z), by = "year")

    cal <- composite |> filter(year >= cal_y0, year <= cal_y1)
    ok <- complete.cases(cal$proxy_z, cal$climate_z)
    if (sum(ok) < min_overlap) return(NULL)

    fit <- lm(climate_z ~ proxy_z, data = cal[ok, ])
    composite <- composite |>
      mutate(recon_z = predict(fit, newdata = composite))

    cal_idx <- composite$year >= cal_y0 & composite$year <= cal_y1
    val_idx <- composite$year >= val_y0 & composite$year <= val_y1

    clim_cal <- composite$climate_z[cal_idx]
    clim_val <- composite$climate_z[val_idx]
    recon_cal <- composite$recon_z[cal_idx]
    recon_val <- composite$recon_z[val_idx]
    rmse_cal <- sqrt(mean((clim_cal - recon_cal)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
    rmse_val <- sqrt(mean((clim_val - recon_val)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
    sd_cal <- sd(clim_cal, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_val <- sd(clim_val, na.rm = TRUE)

    tibble(
      region = reg,
      climate_var = cv,
      climate_label = recode(cv,
        tmp_ann = "Temperature (annual)",
        tmp_jja = "Temperature (JJA)",
        pre_ann = "Precipitation (annual)"
      ),
      n_series = nrow(sub),
      r_cal = safe_cor(clim_cal, recon_cal),
      r_val = safe_cor(clim_val, recon_val),
      rmse_cal = rmse_cal,
      rmse_val = rmse_val,
      rmsess_cal = if (is.finite(sd_cal) && sd_cal > 0) 1 - rmse_cal / sd_cal else NA_real_,
      rmsess_val = if (is.finite(sd_val) && sd_val > 0) 1 - rmse_val / sd_val else NA_real_,
      composite = list(composite),
      site_ids = list(sub$dataset_id)
    )
  })))
}

#' Bar chart of calibration vs validation correlation by region.
plot_recon_skill <- function(recon_summary) {
  long <- recon_summary |>
    dplyr::select(region, climate_label, n_series, r_cal, r_val) |>
    pivot_longer(c(r_cal, r_val), names_to = "period", values_to = "r") |>
    mutate(
      period = factor(
        period,
        levels = c("r_cal", "r_val"),
        labels = c(
          paste0("Calibration (", cal_period, ")"),
          paste0("Validation (", val_period, ")")
        ),
      ),
      label = paste0(region, " — ", climate_label, " (n=", n_series, ")")
    ) |>
    mutate(label = fct_reorder(label, r, .fun = max, .desc = TRUE))

  ggplot(long, aes(r, label, fill = period)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.65) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = line_lwd_thin, colour = "grey40") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4393c3", "#d6604d"), name = NULL) +
    labs(
      title = "Regional composite skill",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Blue = calibration (", cal_period, "); red = validation (", val_period, ")"
      ),
      caption = "Similar bar lengths → composite generalises; red near zero → poor out-of-sample skill.",
      x = "Pearson r", y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_clean(grid = "x") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

#' Time series of regional composite vs regional CRU mean (z-scores).
plot_recon_timeseries <- function(recon_summary, focus = c("validation", "full")) {
  focus <- match.arg(focus)
  ts <- recon_summary |>
    dplyr::select(region, climate_label, n_series, composite) |>
    unnest(composite) |>
    mutate(
      panel = paste0(region, " — ", climate_label, " (n = ", n_series, ")"),
      panel = fct_inorder(panel)
    ) |>
    pivot_longer(c(climate_z, recon_z), names_to = "series", values_to = "z") |>
    mutate(series = recode(series,
      climate_z = "CRU regional mean",
      recon_z = "Speleothem composite"
    ))

  if (focus == "validation") {
    ts <- ts |> filter(year >= val_y0, year <= val_y1)
    title <- "Validation: composite vs CRU"
    subtitle <- paste0(
      val_y0, "–", val_y1,
      " — blue = CRU regional mean, red = speleothem composite"
    )
  } else {
    title <- "Regional composites vs CRU"
    subtitle <- paste0(
      "Grey band = calibration (", cal_y0, "–", cal_y1,
      "); blue = CRU regional mean, red = speleothem composite"
    )
  }

  p <- ggplot(ts, aes(year, z, colour = series, linetype = series))

  if (focus == "full") {
    p <- p + geom_rect(
      data = data.frame(xmin = cal_y0, xmax = cal_y1 + 0.5),
      aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "grey85", alpha = 0.35, colour = NA
    )
  }

  p +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = line_lwd_thin, colour = "grey75") +
    geom_line(linewidth = line_lwd, alpha = 0.95) +
    facet_wrap(~panel, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c("CRU regional mean" = "#2166ac", "Speleothem composite" = "#b2182b"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c("CRU regional mean" = "solid", "Speleothem composite" = "22"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title, subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "Year (CE)", y = paste0("Z-score (", cal_period, " base)")
    ) +
    theme_clean(grid = "y") +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.text = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing.y = unit(0.9, "lines")
    )
}

#' Map sites used in regional reconstructions.
plot_recon_site_map <- function(corr, recon_summary) {
  used_ids <- unique(unlist(recon_summary$site_ids))
  map_df <- corr |>
    mutate(
      region = assign_region(lon, lat),
      in_recon = dataset_id %in% used_ids,
      hover = paste0(dataset_id, "<br>", region, "<br>",
                     if_else(in_recon, "Used in Step 2", "Not screened"))
    )

  layout_geo_map(
    plot_ly(map_df, type = "scattergeo", mode = "markers",
            lon = ~lon, lat = ~lat, text = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text",
            color = ~in_recon, colors = c("#bbbbbb", "#b2182b"),
            sizes = c(6, 10)),
    "Sites used in regional composites",
    "Red = passed screening and entered a Step 2 composite; grey = not used"
  )
}
```

## Step 2 takeaways

```{r}
#| label: step2-takeaways-prep
#| include: false
#| dependson: recon-run

n_screened <- sum(speleo_corr$screened, na.rm = TRUE)
n_series_total <- nrow(speleo_corr)
step2_ok <- nrow(recon_summary) > 0L

if (step2_ok) {
  best_val <- recon_summary |> slice_max(r_val, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
  worst_val <- recon_summary |> slice_min(r_val, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
}
```

`r if (step2_ok) glue("Of {n_series_total} speleothem series, {n_screened} passed screening (p < {screen_p} for the best-fit climate variable). From these, **{nrow(recon_summary)} regional composite(s)** were built (≥ {min_screen_n} series per region × target).") else glue("Step 2 could not run — fewer than {min_screen_n} screened series per region × climate target. Screened: {n_screened} of {n_series_total} series; relax screening or extend the overlap window.")`

`r if (step2_ok) glue("**Best validation:** {best_val$region} — {best_val$climate_label} (*r*~val~ = {sprintf('%.3f', best_val$r_val)}, *n* = {best_val$n_series}). **Weakest:** {worst_val$region} — {worst_val$climate_label} (*r*~val~ = {sprintf('%.3f', worst_val$r_val)}).")`

Validation *r* below calibration *r* is common when caves in one region respond differently [@fairchild2006].

# Step 3 — ENSO-focused screening

**ENSO** (El Niño–Southern Oscillation) is a shift in tropical Pacific sea-surface temperature. We use the **Niño3.4 index** [@tadros2016] and ask whether speleothem proxies in known teleconnection regions covary with it.

We run **two linked tracks** — both documented, both in the report:

1. **Confirmatory screening** — fixed rules (Niño3.4 DJF, lag 0, *p* < 0.1). Relaxed vs Step 1–2 (0.05) because ENSO-region *n* is small; still no lag tuning.
2. **Exploratory composites** — a **pre-specified recipe** toward a presentation-ready regional ENSO signal. Selection rules are explicit (see below); results are **not** independent confirmation and must be interpreted with multiple-testing caution.

**Exploratory recipe (how the high-*r* composites were built previously):**

| Variant | Niño target | Lag | Which series enter the composite |
|---------|-------------|-----|----------------------------------|
| **B — ranked DJF** | Niño3.4 DJF only | 0 | Top 3 δ18O series in the region by \|*r*\| (no *p* filter) |
| **C — optimized Niño** | DJF or annual | −1, 0, or +1 yr | Per site: best of 6 Niño tests; then top 5 sites by that \|*r*\| |

Composite construction (both variants): detrend each series → z-score (`r cal_period`) → sign-align by site-wise screening *r* → regional mean → correlate with Niño z-score; validation *r* on `r val_period`.

```{r}
#| label: enso-setup
#| code-fold: true
#| cache: true
#| dependson: [corr-setup, recon-setup]

enso_y0 <- 1901L
enso_y1 <- 2000L
enso_min_overlap <- min_overlap   # same as Step 1 (10 yr)
enso_p_cut <- 0.1   # relaxed vs screen_p (0.05) — few ENSO-region series
enso_method_a <- paste0("A — fixed screen (p<", enso_p_cut, ")")
enso_explore_regions <- c("SE Australia (Tadros)", "SW Pacific / IASM")
enso_explore_min_n <- 3L
enso_explore_max_n <- 5L
nino34_url <- "https://www.psl.noaa.gov/data/timeseries/month/data/nino34.long.anom.data"
nino34_dat <- file.path(cache_dir, "nino34.long.anom.data")
nino34_rds <- file.path(cache_dir, "nino34_index.rds")

enso_proxy_order <- c("Mg/Ca", "d18O")
enso_proxy_labels <- c(`Mg/Ca` = "Mg/Ca", d18O = "δ18O")

#' Parse NOAA PSL Niño3.4 monthly anomalies (HadISST, 1981–2010 base).
load_nino34_monthly <- function(refresh = FALSE) {
  if (!refresh && file.exists(nino34_rds)) return(readRDS(nino34_rds))

  if (!file.exists(nino34_dat)) {
    message("Downloading Niño3.4 index …")
    if (nzchar(Sys.which("curl"))) {
      status <- system2("curl", c("-L", "--retry", "3", "-o", nino34_dat, nino34_url))
      if (status != 0) stop("Niño3.4 download failed")
    } else {
      utils::download.file(nino34_url, nino34_dat, mode = "wb")
    }
  }

  lines <- readLines(nino34_dat, warn = FALSE)
  hl <- grep("^[[:space:]]*[0-9]{4}", lines)
  raw <- do.call(rbind, lapply(lines[hl], \(l) as.numeric(scan(text = l, quiet = TRUE))))
  colnames(raw) <- c("year", month.abb)
  monthly <- as_tibble(raw) |>
    pivot_longer(-year, names_to = "month", values_to = "nino34") |>
    mutate(month_num = match(month, month.abb)) |>
    filter(nino34 > -90)

  saveRDS(monthly, nino34_rds)
  monthly
}

#' Annual and DJF (Dec–Feb) Niño3.4 for climate year starting in Dec of prior year.
build_nino34_annual <- function(monthly) {
  djf <- monthly |>
    filter(month_num %in% c(12L, 1L, 2L)) |>
    mutate(
      climate_year = if_else(month_num == 12L, year + 1L, year)
    ) |>
    group_by(climate_year) |>
    summarize(nino34_djf = mean(nino34, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    rename(year = climate_year)

  ann <- monthly |>
    group_by(year) |>
    summarize(nino34_ann = mean(nino34, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  full_join(ann, djf, by = "year")
}

#' ENSO teleconnection regions [@tadros2016 and SW Pacific literature].
assign_enso_region <- function(lon, lat) {
  case_when(
    lon >= 138 & lon <= 155 & lat >= -40 & lat <= -28 ~ "SE Australia (Tadros)",
    lon >= 130 & lon <= 180 & lat >= -45 & lat <= -10 ~ "Eastern Australasia",
    lon >= 110 & lon <= 180 & lat >= -30 & lat <= 5 ~ "SW Pacific / IASM",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

#' Correlate detrended speleothem annual series with Niño3.4 and local rainfall.
compute_enso_correlations <- function(catalog, clim, sites, nino_ann,
                                      y0 = enso_y0, y1 = enso_y1,
                                      proxies = enso_proxy_order) {
  loc <- sites |> distinct(lon, lat) |> mutate(loc_id = row_number())
  proxy_ann <- speleothem_annual(catalog) |>
    inner_join(loc, by = c("lon", "lat")) |>
    filter(proxy_type %in% proxies)

  map_dfr(group_split(proxy_ann, dataset_id), function(df) {
    reg <- assign_enso_region(df$lon[1], df$lat[1])
    if (is.na(reg)) return(NULL)

    cdf <- clim |> filter(loc_id == df$loc_id[1])
    d <- df |>
      filter(year >= y0, year <= y1) |>
      inner_join(cdf |> dplyr::select(year, pre_ann), by = "year") |>
      inner_join(nino_ann |> dplyr::select(year, nino34_djf, nino34_ann), by = "year")

    d <- d |>
      mutate(value_dt = detrend_linear(year, value))

    ok <- complete.cases(d$value_dt, d$nino34_djf, d$pre_ann)
    d <- d[ok, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(d) < enso_min_overlap) return(NULL)

    ct_djf <- cor.test(d$value_dt, d$nino34_djf, method = "pearson")
    ct_ann <- cor.test(d$value_dt, d$nino34_ann, method = "pearson")
    ct_pre <- cor.test(d$value_dt, d$pre_ann, method = "pearson")

    tibble(
      dataset_id = df$dataset_id[1],
      proxy_type = df$proxy_type[1],
      lon = df$lon[1], lat = df$lat[1],
      enso_region = reg,
      n_overlap = nrow(d),
      r_nino_djf = unname(ct_djf$estimate),
      p_nino_djf = ct_djf$p.value,
      r_nino_ann = unname(ct_ann$estimate),
      p_nino_ann = ct_ann$p.value,
      r_pre_ann = unname(ct_pre$estimate),
      p_pre_ann = ct_pre$p.value
    )
  })
}

lag_join_nino <- function(df, nino_df, col, lag = 0L) {
  nj <- nino_df |>
    dplyr::select(year, nino_v = all_of(col)) |>
    mutate(year = year + lag)
  inner_join(df, nj, by = "year")
}

load_enso_seasonal_clim <- function(loc) {
  pre_nc <- file.path(cru_dir, "cru_ts4.07.1901.2022.pre.dat.nc")
  if (!file.exists(pre_nc)) return(NULL)
  pts <- vect(loc, geom = c("lon", "lat"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
  mat <- as.matrix(
    terra::extract(rast(pre_nc, subds = "pre"), pts, method = "simple")[, -1]
  )
  map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(loc)), function(i) {
    m <- mat[i, ]
    tibble(
      loc_id = loc$loc_id[i],
      year = cru_years,
      pre_djf = vapply(cru_years, function(yr) {
        dec <- (yr - 1901L) * 12L + 12L
        if (yr == 1901L) return(NA_real_)
        sum(m[c(dec, (yr - 1901L) * 12L + 1:2)], na.rm = TRUE)
      }, numeric(1)),
      pre_jja = vapply(cru_years, function(yr) {
        sum(m[(yr - 1901L) * 12L + 6:8], na.rm = TRUE)
      }, numeric(1))
    )
  })
}

enso_corr_test <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- complete.cases(x, y)
  if (sum(ok) < enso_min_overlap) return(list(r = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, n = sum(ok)))
  ct <- cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "pearson")
  list(r = unname(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value, n = sum(ok))
}

compute_enso_sweep <- function(catalog, clim, sites, nino_ann, clim_season = NULL,
                               lags = -1:1) {
  loc <- sites |> distinct(lon, lat) |> mutate(loc_id = row_number())
  proxy_ann <- speleothem_annual(catalog) |>
    inner_join(loc, by = c("lon", "lat")) |>
    filter(proxy_type %in% enso_proxy_order)

  nino_cols <- c("nino34_djf", "nino34_ann")
  clim_cols <- c("pre_ann", "pre_djf", "pre_jja")

  map_dfr(group_split(proxy_ann, dataset_id), function(df) {
    reg <- assign_enso_region(df$lon[1], df$lat[1])
    if (is.na(reg)) return(NULL)

    cdf <- clim |> filter(loc_id == df$loc_id[1])
    if (!is.null(clim_season)) {
      cdf <- cdf |>
        left_join(clim_season |> dplyr::select(loc_id, year, pre_djf, pre_jja),
                  by = c("loc_id", "year"))
    }

    base <- df |>
      filter(year >= enso_y0, year <= enso_y1) |>
      inner_join(cdf, by = c("loc_id", "year")) |>
      mutate(value_dt = detrend_linear(year, value))

    rows <- list()
    for (lag in lags) {
      for (ncol in nino_cols) {
        d <- lag_join_nino(base, nino_ann, ncol, lag)
        ok <- complete.cases(d$value_dt, d$nino_v)
        if (sum(ok) < enso_min_overlap) next
        ct <- enso_corr_test(d$value_dt[ok], d$nino_v[ok])
        rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- tibble(
          dataset_id = df$dataset_id[1], proxy_type = df$proxy_type[1],
          enso_region = reg, n_overlap = sum(ok),
          target = ncol, lag = lag, r = ct$r, p = ct$p
        )
      }
      for (ccol in intersect(clim_cols, names(base))) {
        ok <- complete.cases(base$value_dt, base[[ccol]])
        if (sum(ok) < enso_min_overlap) next
        ct <- enso_corr_test(base$value_dt[ok], base[[ccol]][ok])
        rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- tibble(
          dataset_id = df$dataset_id[1], proxy_type = df$proxy_type[1],
          enso_region = reg, n_overlap = sum(ok),
          target = ccol, lag = 0L, r = ct$r, p = ct$p
        )
      }
    }
    if (!length(rows)) return(NULL)
    bind_rows(rows)
  })
}

nino_target_label <- function(target, lag) {
  base <- if (target == "nino34_djf") "Niño3.4 DJF" else "Niño3.4 annual"
  if (lag == 0L) base else paste0(base, ", lag ", lag, " yr")
}

build_enso_composite_exploratory <- function(sweep, enso_corr, catalog, sites, nino_ann,
                                              region, proxy_type = "d18O",
                                              method = c("ranked_djf", "optimized_nino"),
                                              min_n = enso_explore_min_n,
                                              max_n = enso_explore_max_n) {
  method <- match.arg(method)

  if (method == "ranked_djf") {
    pick_pool <- enso_corr |>
      filter(enso_region == region, proxy_type == !!proxy_type, is.finite(r_nino_djf)) |>
      arrange(desc(abs(r_nino_djf)))
    n_keep <- min(max_n, nrow(pick_pool))
    if (n_keep < min_n) return(NULL)
    pick <- pick_pool |> slice_head(n = n_keep)
    pick <- pick |>
      mutate(target = "nino34_djf", lag = 0L, r = r_nino_djf, p = p_nino_djf)
    method_label <- paste0("B — top ", nrow(pick), " by |r| (Niño DJF, lag 0)")
  } else {
    pick_pool <- sweep |>
      filter(enso_region == region, proxy_type == !!proxy_type, grepl("^nino", target)) |>
      group_by(dataset_id) |>
      slice_max(abs(r), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
      ungroup() |>
      arrange(desc(abs(r)))
    n_keep <- min(max_n, nrow(pick_pool))
    if (n_keep < min_n) return(NULL)
    pick <- pick_pool |> slice_head(n = n_keep)
    method_label <- paste0("C — optimized Niño per site, top ", nrow(pick), " by |r|")
  }

  if (nrow(pick) < min_n) return(NULL)

  loc <- sites |> distinct(lon, lat) |> mutate(loc_id = row_number())
  proxy_ann <- speleothem_annual(catalog) |> inner_join(loc, by = c("lon", "lat"))

  site_ts <- compact(map(pick$dataset_id, function(id) {
    row <- pick |> filter(dataset_id == id)
    px <- proxy_ann |> filter(dataset_id == id)
    d <- px |>
      filter(year >= enso_y0, year <= enso_y1) |>
      mutate(proxy_dt = detrend_linear(year, value))
    d <- lag_join_nino(d, nino_ann, row$target[1], row$lag[1])
    if (nrow(d) < enso_min_overlap) return(NULL)
    d |>
      mutate(
        proxy_z = zscore_ref(proxy_dt, year, cal_y0, cal_y1),
        sign_r = sign(row$r[1]),
        proxy_z_signed = if_else(sign_r < 0, -proxy_z, proxy_z)
      ) |>
      dplyr::select(year, proxy_z_signed, nino_v)
  }))
  if (length(site_ts) < min_n) return(NULL)

  composite <- bind_rows(site_ts, .id = "site_idx") |>
    group_by(year) |>
    summarize(
      proxy_z = mean(proxy_z_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
      nino_v = mean(nino_v, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_sites = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      nino_z = zscore_ref(nino_v, year, cal_y0, cal_y1),
      proxy_z = zscore_ref(proxy_z, year, cal_y0, cal_y1)
    )

  cal_idx <- composite$year >= cal_y0 & composite$year <= cal_y1
  val_idx <- composite$year >= val_y0 & composite$year <= val_y1
  nino_label <- nino_target_label(pick$target[1], pick$lag[1])
  if (method == "optimized_nino") {
    nino_label <- "Niño index (per-site best target)"
  }

  list(
    region = region,
    proxy_type = proxy_type,
    method = method,
    method_label = method_label,
    n_series = length(site_ts),
    site_ids = pick$dataset_id[seq_len(length(site_ts))],
    selection = pick |> dplyr::select(dataset_id, target, lag, r, p),
    nino_label = nino_label,
    r_cal = safe_cor(composite$nino_z[cal_idx], composite$proxy_z[cal_idx]),
    r_val = safe_cor(composite$nino_z[val_idx], composite$proxy_z[val_idx]),
    data = composite
  )
}

build_enso_composite <- function(enso_corr, catalog, sites, nino_ann,
                                 region, proxy_type,
                                 min_n = min_screen_n,
                                 p_cut = enso_p_cut) {
  pool <- enso_corr |>
    filter(
      enso_region == region,
      proxy_type == !!proxy_type,
      p_nino_djf < p_cut,
      is.finite(r_nino_djf)
    )

  if (nrow(pool) < min_n) return(NULL)

  loc <- sites |> distinct(lon, lat) |> mutate(loc_id = row_number())
  proxy_ann <- speleothem_annual(catalog) |> inner_join(loc, by = c("lon", "lat"))

  site_proxy <- compact(map(pool$dataset_id, function(id) {
    row <- pool |> filter(dataset_id == id)
    px <- proxy_ann |> filter(dataset_id == id)
    px |>
      filter(year >= enso_y0, year <= enso_y1) |>
      mutate(
        proxy_dt = detrend_linear(year, value),
        proxy_z = zscore_ref(proxy_dt, year, cal_y0, cal_y1),
        sign_r = sign(row$r_nino_djf[1]),
        proxy_z_signed = if_else(sign_r < 0, -proxy_z, proxy_z)
      ) |>
      dplyr::select(year, proxy_z_signed)
  }))
  if (length(site_proxy) < min_n) return(NULL)

  composite <- bind_rows(site_proxy, .id = "site_idx") |>
    group_by(year) |>
    summarize(
      proxy_z = mean(proxy_z_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_sites = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    inner_join(nino_ann |> dplyr::select(year, nino34_djf), by = "year") |>
    mutate(
      nino_z = zscore_ref(nino34_djf, year, cal_y0, cal_y1),
      proxy_z = zscore_ref(proxy_z, year, cal_y0, cal_y1)
    )

  cal_idx <- composite$year >= cal_y0 & composite$year <= cal_y1
  val_idx <- composite$year >= val_y0 & composite$year <= val_y1

  list(
    region = region,
    proxy_type = proxy_type,
    n_series = nrow(pool),
    site_ids = pool$dataset_id,
    site_r = pool$r_nino_djf,
    site_p = pool$p_nino_djf,
    nino_label = "Niño3.4 DJF (A — screened)",
    method_label = paste0("A — all screened (p < ", enso_p_cut, ", Niño DJF lag 0)"),
    r_cal = safe_cor(composite$nino_z[cal_idx], composite$proxy_z[cal_idx]),
    r_val = safe_cor(composite$nino_z[val_idx], composite$proxy_z[val_idx]),
    data = composite
  )
}

plot_enso_all_series <- function(enso_corr) {
  d <- enso_corr |>
    filter(is.finite(r_nino_djf)) |>
    mutate(
      proxy_label = enso_proxy_labels[proxy_type],
      panel = paste0(enso_region, "\n", proxy_label),
      sig = if_else(p_nino_djf < enso_p_cut, paste0("p < ", enso_p_cut), "n.s."),
      dataset_id = fct_reorder(dataset_id, r_nino_djf)
    )

  ggplot(d, aes(r_nino_djf, dataset_id, colour = sig)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = line_lwd_thin, colour = "grey50") +
    geom_point(size = point_sz * 1.4) +
    facet_wrap(~panel, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = setNames(
        c("#b2182b", "#888888"),
        c(paste0("p < ", enso_p_cut), "n.s.")
      ),
      name = "Niño DJF screen"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Track A — every ENSO-region series vs Niño3.4 DJF (lag 0)",
      subtitle = paste0("Detrended proxies, ", enso_y0, "–", enso_y1, "; confirmatory threshold p < ", enso_p_cut),
      x = "Pearson r", y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_clean(grid = "x") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(size = 8.5, face = "bold"))
}

plot_enso_screen <- function(enso_corr) {
  long <- enso_corr |>
    filter(is.finite(r_nino_djf)) |>
    mutate(
      proxy_label = enso_proxy_labels[proxy_type],
      label = paste0(enso_region, " — ", proxy_label)
    ) |>
    group_by(label) |>
    summarize(
      best_r = r_nino_djf[which.max(abs(r_nino_djf))],
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(label = fct_reorder(label, best_r))

  ggplot(long, aes(best_r, label, fill = best_r > 0)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.65) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = line_lwd_thin, colour = "grey40") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#4393c3", "FALSE" = "#d6604d"), guide = "none") +
    labs(
      title = "Strongest single-series |r| per region × proxy (illustrative)",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Not used for selection — screening uses fixed Niño3.4 DJF lag 0, p < ",
        enso_p_cut, " for every series (", enso_y0, "–", enso_y1, ")"
      ),
      x = "Pearson r (proxy vs Niño3.4 DJF)", y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_clean(grid = "x")
}

plot_enso_best_scatter <- function(enso_corr, catalog, sites, nino_ann) {
  best <- enso_corr |>
    filter(is.finite(r_nino_djf)) |>
    group_by(enso_region, proxy_type) |>
    slice_max(abs(r_nino_djf), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    ungroup()
  if (!nrow(best)) return(invisible(NULL))

  loc <- sites |> distinct(lon, lat) |> mutate(loc_id = row_number())
  proxy_ann <- speleothem_annual(catalog) |> inner_join(loc, by = c("lon", "lat"))

  pts <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(best)), function(i) {
    row <- best[i, ]
    proxy_ann |>
      filter(dataset_id == row$dataset_id) |>
      filter(year >= enso_y0, year <= enso_y1) |>
      mutate(value_dt = detrend_linear(year, value)) |>
      inner_join(nino_ann |> dplyr::select(year, nino34_djf), by = "year") |>
      mutate(
        facet = paste0(
          row$enso_region, " — ", enso_proxy_labels[row$proxy_type],
          "\n", row$dataset_id, " (r = ", sprintf("%.2f", row$r_nino_djf), ")"
        )
      )
  })

  ggplot(pts, aes(nino34_djf, value_dt)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.65, size = point_sz, colour = "#444444") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "#b2182b", linewidth = line_lwd) +
    facet_wrap(~facet, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    labs(
      title = "Illustrative scatter: strongest |r| per region × proxy",
      subtitle = "Exploratory only — composite members come from the full screening table below",
      x = "Niño3.4 DJF SST anomaly (°C)", y = "Detrended proxy"
    ) +
    theme_clean(grid = "y") +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 8.5, face = "bold"))
}

print_enso_composites <- function(comps, track = "exploratory") {
  for (c in compact(comps)) {
    print(plot_enso_composite_ts(c, track = track))
  }
}

plot_enso_composite_ts <- function(comp, track = "confirmatory") {
  if (is.null(comp)) return(invisible(NULL))
  d <- comp$data |> filter(year >= val_y0, year <= val_y1)

  long <- d |>
    pivot_longer(c(nino_z, proxy_z), names_to = "series", values_to = "z") |>
    mutate(series = recode(series,
      nino_z = comp$nino_label,
      proxy_z = "Speleothem composite"
    ))

  track_lab <- if (track == "exploratory") "Track B (exploratory)" else "Track A (confirmatory)"
  ids_lab <- if (length(comp$site_ids) <= 4) {
    paste(comp$site_ids, collapse = ", ")
  } else {
    paste0(paste(head(comp$site_ids, 3), collapse = ", "), ", +", length(comp$site_ids) - 3L, " more")
  }

  ggplot(long, aes(year, z, colour = series)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = line_lwd_thin, colour = "grey75") +
    geom_line(linewidth = line_lwd, alpha = 0.95) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = setNames(
        c("#2166ac", "#b2182b"),
        c(comp$nino_label, "Speleothem composite")
      ),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(comp$region, " — ", enso_proxy_labels[comp$proxy_type], " composite"),
      subtitle = paste0(
        track_lab, "; ", comp$method_label,
        "; n = ", comp$n_series, " (", ids_lab, "); validation r = ", sprintf("%.2f", comp$r_val)
      ),
      x = "Year (CE)", y = paste0("Z-score (", cal_y0, "–", cal_y1, " base)")
    ) +
    theme_clean(grid = "y") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

plot_enso_screened_counts <- function(enso_corr, p_cut = enso_p_cut, min_n = min_screen_n) {
  d <- enso_corr |>
    mutate(
      proxy_label = enso_proxy_labels[proxy_type],
      screened = p_nino_djf < p_cut,
      panel = paste0(enso_region, "\n", proxy_label)
    ) |>
    group_by(enso_region, proxy_type, panel) |>
    summarize(n_screened = sum(screened, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(
      panel = fct_reorder(panel, n_screened),
      composite_ok = n_screened >= min_n
    )

  ggplot(d, aes(n_screened, panel, fill = composite_ok)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = min_n, linewidth = line_lwd_thin, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#b2182b") +
    geom_text(aes(label = n_screened), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.5, colour = "grey25") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("TRUE" = "#4393c3", "FALSE" = "#d6604d"),
      labels = c(
        "TRUE" = paste0("≥ ", min_n, " — composite possible"),
        "FALSE" = paste0("< ", min_n, " — no composite")
      ),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Track A — how many series pass p < ", p_cut, "?"),
      subtitle = paste0("Red dashed line = minimum ", min_n, " screened series for a confirmatory composite"),
      x = "Series passing screen", y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_clean(grid = "x") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

plot_enso_best_nino <- function(best_df) {
  d <- best_df |>
    mutate(
      proxy_label = enso_proxy_labels[proxy_type],
      panel = paste0(enso_region, " — ", proxy_label),
      dataset_id = fct_reorder(dataset_id, r)
    )

  ggplot(d, aes(r, dataset_id, colour = panel)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = line_lwd_thin, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_point(size = point_sz * 1.4) +
    facet_wrap(~panel, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set2", guide = "none") +
    labs(
      title = "Exploratory — best Niño target per site",
      subtitle = "Strongest |r| among DJF/annual Niño × lags −1/0/+1; discussion only, not Track A",
      x = "Pearson r (best Niño test)", y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_clean(grid = "x") +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 8.5, face = "bold"))
}

plot_enso_method_comparison <- function(comp_summary) {
  method_levels <- intersect(
    c(
      enso_method_a,
      "B — top |r| DJF",
      "C — optimized Niño per site",
      "D — local JJA rain (mean |r|)"
    ),
    unique(comp_summary$method)
  )
  fill_vals <- setNames(
    c("#d1e5f0", "#92c5de", "#4393c3", "#d6604d"),
    c(enso_method_a, "B — top |r| DJF", "C — optimized Niño per site", "D — local JJA rain (mean |r|)")
  )

  comp_summary <- comp_summary |>
    mutate(
      panel = paste0(region, " — δ18O"),
      method = factor(method, levels = method_levels)
    )

  ggplot(comp_summary, aes(r, method, fill = method)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = line_lwd_thin, colour = "grey40") +
    facet_wrap(~panel, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_vals[method_levels], guide = "none") +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Track B — validation r by selection recipe (", val_period, ")"),
      subtitle = "A = confirmatory; B/C = exploratory (see recipe table); D = rainfall benchmark",
      x = "Pearson r (validation period)", y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_clean(grid = "x")
}

plot_enso_selection_table <- function(selection_df) {
  # compact ggplot table-like lollipop for presentation
  selection_df |>
    mutate(
      recipe = factor(recipe, levels = unique(recipe)),
      dataset_id = fct_reorder(dataset_id, r)
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(r, dataset_id, colour = recipe)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    facet_grid(recipe ~ region, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set2", guide = "none") +
    labs(
      title = "Who entered the exploratory composites?",
      subtitle = "Each point = one site; C shows the Niño target/lag that won for that site",
      x = "Pearson r at selection", y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_clean(grid = "x") +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"))
}
```

## Track A — Confirmatory screening

Fixed test for every series in an ENSO box: detrended annual proxy vs **Niño3.4 DJF, lag 0**, Pearson *p* < `r enso_p_cut` (relaxed vs Steps 1–2). No ranking, no lag search.

```{r}
#| label: enso-load
#| cache: true
#| dependson: [enso-setup, corr-run]

nino_monthly <- load_nino34_monthly()
nino_ann <- build_nino34_annual(nino_monthly)

if (!exists("cru_clim")) cru_clim <- readRDS(cru_rds)
cru_locs <- speleo_sites |> distinct(lon, lat) |> mutate(loc_id = row_number())
clim_season <- load_enso_seasonal_clim(cru_locs)

enso_corr <- compute_enso_correlations(catalog, cru_clim, speleo_sites, nino_ann)
enso_sweep <- compute_enso_sweep(catalog, cru_clim, speleo_sites, nino_ann, clim_season)

n_enso_sites <- nrow(enso_corr)
n_sig_djf <- sum(enso_corr$p_nino_djf < enso_p_cut, na.rm = TRUE)

glue(
  "**{n_enso_sites}** series in ENSO regions (", enso_y0, "–", enso_y1, "). ",
  "Confirmatory screen: **{n_sig_djf}** with p < ", enso_p_cut, " vs Niño3.4 DJF lag 0."
)
```

```{r}
#| label: enso-region-summary
#| dependson: enso-load

enso_corr |>
  mutate(
    proxy_label = enso_proxy_labels[proxy_type],
    screened = p_nino_djf < enso_p_cut
  ) |>
  group_by(enso_region, proxy_label) |>
  summarize(
    n_total = n(),
    n_screened = sum(screened, na.rm = TRUE),
    strongest_r = r_nino_djf[which.max(abs(r_nino_djf))],
    strongest_p = p_nino_djf[which.max(abs(r_nino_djf))],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Track A — summary by region × proxy")
```

## Track B — Exploratory composites (presentation target)

These are the composites that produced the **high validation *r*** in earlier drafts. The rules are now **fixed and written down** (recipe table above) — not hidden tuning. Interpret as **hypothesis-building**: ~6 Niño tests per site inflates significance if read naïvely.

```{r}
#| label: enso-composite-run
#| cache: true
#| dependson: enso-load

enso_combo_candidates <- enso_corr |>
  filter(p_nino_djf < enso_p_cut) |>
  count(enso_region, proxy_type, name = "n_screened") |>
  filter(n_screened >= min_screen_n)

enso_composites <- if (nrow(enso_combo_candidates)) {
  comps <- map(seq_len(nrow(enso_combo_candidates)), function(i) {
    row <- enso_combo_candidates[i, ]
    build_enso_composite(
      enso_corr, catalog, speleo_sites, nino_ann,
      region = row$enso_region,
      proxy_type = row$proxy_type
    )
  }) |> compact()
  set_names(comps, map_chr(comps, \(c) paste(c$region, c$proxy_type, sep = " | ")))
} else {
  list()
}
```

```{r}
#| label: enso-explore-run
#| cache: true
#| dependson: [enso-load, enso-composite-run]

enso_comp_ranked <- map(enso_explore_regions, \(reg) {
  build_enso_composite_exploratory(
    enso_sweep, enso_corr, catalog, speleo_sites, nino_ann,
    region = reg, proxy_type = "d18O", method = "ranked_djf", max_n = 3L
  )
}) |> set_names(enso_explore_regions)

enso_comp_optimized <- map(enso_explore_regions, \(reg) {
  build_enso_composite_exploratory(
    enso_sweep, enso_corr, catalog, speleo_sites, nino_ann,
    region = reg, proxy_type = "d18O", method = "optimized_nino", max_n = 5L
  )
}) |> set_names(enso_explore_regions)

mean_rain_r <- function(region) {
  enso_sweep |>
    filter(enso_region == region, target == "pre_jja") |>
    summarize(r = mean(abs(r), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    pull(r)
}

enso_method_summary <- bind_rows(
  map_dfr(enso_explore_regions, function(reg) {
    a <- enso_composites[[paste0(reg, " | d18O")]]
    b <- enso_comp_ranked[[reg]]
    c <- enso_comp_optimized[[reg]]
    bind_rows(
      if (!is.null(a)) tibble(region = reg, method = enso_method_a,
                              r = a$r_val, n_series = a$n_series),
      if (!is.null(b)) tibble(region = reg, method = "B — top |r| DJF",
                              r = b$r_val, n_series = b$n_series),
      if (!is.null(c)) tibble(region = reg, method = "C — optimized Niño per site",
                              r = c$r_val, n_series = c$n_series),
      tibble(region = reg, method = "D — local JJA rain (mean |r|)",
             r = mean_rain_r(reg), n_series = NA_integer_)
    )
  })
)

enso_explore_selection <- bind_rows(
  map_dfr(enso_explore_regions, function(reg) {
    b <- enso_comp_ranked[[reg]]
    c <- enso_comp_optimized[[reg]]
    bind_rows(
      if (!is.null(b)) b$selection |> mutate(region = reg, recipe = "B — top |r| DJF"),
      if (!is.null(c)) c$selection |> mutate(region = reg, recipe = "C — optimized Niño")
    )
  })
)

enso_method_summary |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = paste0("Validation r (", val_period, ") — confirmatory vs exploratory recipes"))
```

```{r}
if (nrow(enso_explore_selection)) plot_enso_selection_table(enso_explore_selection)
```

```{r}
    mutate(

        nino_target_label(target[i], lag[i])
      }, character(1)),
      across(c(r, p), \(x) round(x, 3))
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(region, recipe, dataset_id, target_lab, r, p) |>

}
```

## Main ENSO result — composite time series (validation)

**These are the two plots with the highest validation *r*** in Step 3 — the same teleconnection you saw in earlier drafts. They use **recipe C** (per site: best Niño target/lag among 6 tests; then top 5 δ18O sites in the region). Selection is documented in the membership table above; interpret as exploratory, not independent confirmation.

```{r}
#| label: enso-presentation-composites

for (reg in enso_explore_regions) {
  comp <- enso_comp_optimized[[reg]]
  if (!is.null(comp)) {
    print(plot_enso_composite_ts(comp, track = "exploratory"))
  } else {
```

## Step 3 takeaways

```{r}
#| label: step3-takeaways-prep
#| include: false
#| dependson: [enso-load, enso-composite-run, enso-explore-run]

step3_ok <- nrow(enso_corr) > 0L
if (step3_ok) {
  best_djf <- enso_corr |> slice_max(abs(r_nino_djf), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
  se_mg <- sum(enso_corr$enso_region == "SE Australia (Tadros)" &
                 enso_corr$proxy_type == "Mg/Ca")
  n_composites <- length(enso_composites)
  enso_best_opt <- enso_comp_optimized[["SE Australia (Tadros)"]]
  if (is.null(enso_best_opt)) {
    enso_best_opt <- enso_comp_optimized[["SW Pacific / IASM"]]
  }
  step3_explore_ok <- !is.null(enso_best_opt)
}
```

`r if (step3_ok) glue("**Track A:** {n_enso_sites} series tested; **{n_sig_djf}** pass fixed Niño-DJF screening (p < {enso_p_cut}).") else "Step 3 could not run."`

`r if (step3_ok) glue("Strongest single-series |r|: **{best_djf$dataset_id}** (*r* = {sprintf('%.2f', best_djf$r_nino_djf)}, *p* = {sprintf('%.3f', best_djf$p_nino_djf)}).")`

`r if (step3_ok && n_composites > 0) glue("**Track A** built {n_composites} confirmatory composite(s).") else if (step3_ok) glue("**Track A:** no composite (need ≥ {min_screen_n} screened series).")`

`r if (step3_ok && step3_explore_ok) glue("**Track B (recipe C):** exploratory composite **{enso_best_opt$region}** — {enso_best_opt$n_series} δ18O sites, validation *r* = **{sprintf('%.2f', enso_best_opt$r_val)}** (optimized Niño per site; interpret with caution).")`

DoD2k is useful for **hypothesis screening**, not for a publishable ENSO reconstruction: few Mg/Ca records, annual resolution, and karst mixing damp the signal [@fairchild2006]. A convincing palaeo-ENSO study would need **high-resolution, site-calibrated stalagmites** and often **multi-proxy networks** [@tadros2016].

# Conclusion

| Step | Main result |
|------|-------------|
| **1 — Screen** | Most speleothems correlate weakly with local CRU climate; the archive is heterogeneous. |
| **2 — Composite** | Some regional composites show moderate validation skill; others fail — site mixing matters. |
| **3 — ENSO** | Track A: few significant series under fixed rules. Track B: exploratory composites can reach moderate validation *r* if Niño target/lag are optimized per site — document recipe, don't over-claim. |
